info.title: API.SH: Woolworths
info.description: The Woolworths API from API.SH: public Woolworths data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Return only this branch (a category id such as 1_6E4F4E4, its slug such as dairy-eggs-fridge, a browse path such as dairy-eggs-fridge/milk, or a woolworths.com.au/shop/browse/... link; a slug used in several places means the highest one in the tree). The products of a branch are on /woolworths/v1/category.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every product in one Woolworths (Australia) category, page by page: a department (Dairy, Eggs & Fridge), an aisle (Milk) or a shelf (Full Cream Milk), or a specials group or branch (half price, half price in Pantry). Each product has the same fields as /woolworths/v1/search: stockcode, barcode and `gtin13`, name, brand, link, package size, price, was price and savings, unit price, in-store price, special / half-price flags, promotion text, multibuy and member prices, stock and availability for delivery, pickup and express, sponsored flag, departments and categories, ingredients, allergens, dietary claims, health star rating, nutrition and images, with size variants under `variants`. Also returned: `total`, the category (id, name, level, link and its `path` from the department down), its `subcategories` (pass an id back as `id`), and `facets`: the brand, dietary, allergen, health star and Everyday Market seller values with counts, each with the parameter that filters by it. `gtin13` is the barcode printed on the pack (EAN-13; an EAN-8 is zero-padded to 13 digits), the code to match products with other retailers: Woolworths' own record of the pack barcode, matched by stockcode. It is not derived from `barcode`, which is Woolworths' internal trade code (mostly a 14-digit GTIN-14 whose item number often differs from the pack's, so never strip it into an EAN-13). `gtin13` is null for products without a pack barcode (most Everyday Market partner listings), for in-store numbers (02, 04, 20-29: items weighed or packed in store, such as loose fruit, deli or bakery bread) and for case or multipack codes, and when the pack barcode could not be confirmed on this call: `gtin13_unconfirmed` counts those (normally 0; ask again for them). `location` says what the prices are for: woolworths.com.au shows the same online prices to every signed-out shopper, so `prices_for_location` is always false.

Paging: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. The site lists at most the first 10,000 products of one category (`total_capped` is true when it has more): page the `subcategories` of such a department instead. To collect a whole category use `sort=name` (or a price sort): the relevance order can shift between pages, so a product may move past a page boundary. Sponsored products (`sponsored: true`, counted in `sponsored_count`) come on top of the page's own products and may also appear in their own place in the list. Subcategories whose id ends in `_SPECIALS` list that category's specials and offers. Age-restricted categories (tobacco) answer 403: the site lists them only to signed-in shoppers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The category: its id from /woolworths/v1/categories or `subcategories` (1_6E4F4E4), its slug (dairy-eggs-fridge), a browse path (dairy-eggs-fridge/milk, specials/half-price/pantry), or a woolworths.com.au/shop/browse/... link. A slug used in several places means the highest one in the tree.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, unit_price_asc, unit_price_desc, name. Use name or a price order to page through a whole category.

parameters.name: specials
parameters.description: true for the category's products on special only.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Only these brands, as listed in the Brand facet (e.g. `a2,Pauls`): comma-separated without a space, or repeat the parameter. A comma followed by a space stays part of the name.

parameters.name: dietary
parameters.description: Only products with these dietary and lifestyle claims, as listed in the Dietary and Lifestyle facet (e.g. `Vegan`, `Gluten Free`); several as for `brand`.

parameters.name: allergens
parameters.description: Only products with these allergen claims, as listed in the Allergens facet (e.g. `Dairy Free`, `Nut Free`); several as for `brand`.

parameters.name: health_star
parameters.description: Only products with these health star ratings, as listed in the Health Star Rating facet (e.g. `4.5,5`).

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Only products from these Everyday Market partners, as listed in that facet; several as for `brand`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-36 (default 24). Sponsored products come on top.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first, up to 10,000 / `limit` (278 at 36). Pass back `next_page`.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: 4-digit Australian postcode. Echoed in `location`; prices stay the site's online prices (it lets only signed-in shoppers choose a store). In-store availability near a postcode is on /woolworths/v1/product.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store number from /woolworths/v1/stores (e.g. 1449). Echoed in `location`; prices stay the site's online prices. In-store availability at a store is on /woolworths/v1/product.

get.description:
One Woolworths product by stockcode, link or barcode: everything in search (price, unit price, promotion, availability, ingredients, allergens, dietary claims, health star rating, nutrition per 100 g and per serve, storage and usage) plus all product attributes, the star rating, rating count and recent reviews. `gtin13` is the barcode printed on the pack (EAN-13; an EAN-8 is zero-padded to 13 digits), the code to match products with other retailers: Woolworths' own record of the pack barcode, matched by stockcode. It is not derived from `barcode`, which is Woolworths' internal trade code (mostly a 14-digit GTIN-14 whose item number often differs from the pack's, so never strip it into an EAN-13). `gtin13` is null for products without a pack barcode (most Everyday Market partner listings), for in-store numbers (02, 04, 20-29: items weighed or packed in store, such as loose fruit, deli or bakery bread) and for case or multipack codes, and when the pack barcode could not be confirmed on this call: `gtin13_unconfirmed` counts those (normally 0; ask again for them). With `postcode` or `store`, `location.store` is that store (or the nearest supermarket to the postcode that lists the product) with `instore_available` (null when the site does not say), and `store_availability` lists the nearby supermarkets the site shows (up to 5) (number, name, address, distance) and whether each has the product in stock; prices stay the site's online prices, the same for every signed-out shopper (`prices_for_location` false). The list is empty for products the site sells online only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The stockcode (the number in a woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/<id>/... link) or that link. Required unless `barcode` is given.

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: Look the product up by the barcode on the pack instead of `id`: the 13-digit EAN as in `gtin13` (e.g. 9300633556150), an EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC, or the 14-digit code in `barcode`. 404 when Woolworths has no product with it.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: 4-digit Australian postcode: adds in-store availability at the nearest supermarkets (`location`, `store_availability`).

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store number from /woolworths/v1/stores (e.g. 1449): adds whether that store has the product in stock (`location.store.instore_available`) and nearby stores (`store_availability`). 404 for an unknown store number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Woolworths (Australia) product search: stockcode, barcode, name, brand, link, package size, price, was price and savings, unit price (per kg/L), in-store price, special / half-price flags, promotion text, multibuy and member prices, stock and availability for delivery, pickup and express, departments and categories, ingredients, allergens (contains / may contain), dietary and lifestyle claims, health star rating, nutrition panel per 100 g and per serve, images, and size variants. `gtin13` is the barcode printed on the pack (EAN-13; an EAN-8 is zero-padded to 13 digits), the code to match products with other retailers: Woolworths' own record of the pack barcode, matched by stockcode. It is not derived from `barcode`, which is Woolworths' internal trade code (mostly a 14-digit GTIN-14 whose item number often differs from the pack's, so never strip it into an EAN-13). `gtin13` is null for products without a pack barcode (most Everyday Market partner listings), for in-store numbers (02, 04, 20-29: items weighed or packed in store, such as loose fruit, deli or bakery bread) and for case or multipack codes, and when the pack barcode could not be confirmed on this call: `gtin13_unconfirmed` counts those (normally 0; ask again for them). `location` says what the prices are for: woolworths.com.au shows the same online prices to every signed-out shopper and lets only signed-in shoppers choose a store or delivery address, so `prices_for_location` is always false; `selected` is false with no `postcode`/`store`. `facets` lists the departments the results fall into; `related_searches` the site's suggested refinements. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. The site serves the first 10,000 results of a search (`total_capped` is true when there are more; pages past 10,000 / `limit`, e.g. 278 at 36, answer 400): narrow the search or list categories with /woolworths/v1/category.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-search

get.description:
Woolworths (Australia) specials by group (half price, lower shelf price, everyday low price, seasonal price, buy more save more, online only, bundles, Everyday Market), optionally narrowed to one department: total, and each product's stockcode, name, brand, link, package size, price, was price and savings, unit price, special / half-price flags, promotion text, multibuy and member prices, stock and availability, sponsored flag, departments, ingredients, allergens, dietary claims, health star rating, nutrition and images. `gtin13` is the barcode printed on the pack (EAN-13; an EAN-8 is zero-padded to 13 digits), the code to match products with other retailers: Woolworths' own record of the pack barcode, matched by stockcode. It is not derived from `barcode`, which is Woolworths' internal trade code (mostly a 14-digit GTIN-14 whose item number often differs from the pack's, so never strip it into an EAN-13). `gtin13` is null for products without a pack barcode (most Everyday Market partner listings), for in-store numbers (02, 04, 20-29: items weighed or packed in store, such as loose fruit, deli or bakery bread) and for case or multipack codes, and when the pack barcode could not be confirmed on this call: `gtin13_unconfirmed` counts those (normally 0; ask again for them). `location` says what the prices are for: woolworths.com.au shows the same online prices to every signed-out shopper and lets only signed-in shoppers choose a store or delivery address, so `prices_for_location` is always false; `selected` is false with no `postcode`/`store`. `facets` lists brands, allergens, dietary and health star filters with counts; `groups` and `departments` list the values to pass back. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. A group lists at most its first 10,000 products (`total_capped`; pages past 10,000 / `limit` answer 400): page its departments for the rest. To collect a whole group page it with `sort=name`; a group lists products that sit in none of its departments, so page the group rather than adding up departments.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-specials

get.description:
Woolworths stores nearest an Australian postcode: store number, name, division, address, suburb, state, postcode, phone, coordinates, distance in km, open now, trading hours for the week ahead and facilities.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/woolworths-stores

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: 4-digit Australian postcode.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores to return, 1-50 (default 10).

parameters.name: division
parameters.description: Store type: SUPERMARKETS (default, includes Metro stores), PETROL, AMPOL, AMPOLMETRO, CALTEXWOW, EG; several comma-separated.

parameters.name: facility
parameters.description: Only stores with this facility (as named in `facilities`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
